mentions.name: GenMotion
mentions.description: An IDE for visual designers to create motion graphics, described as cursor/lovable for videos. It connects to many MCP servers for image, SFX, video, and audio generation while giving the user fine-grained control, and is used to produce launch videos and feature announcement videos.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an IDE for visual desiners to create motion graphics. Somewhat like cursor/lovable for videos. It can connect to tons of MCP servers to do image, SFX, video and audio generations and give fine grained control over to the user.
